concept.title: Regular expressions with auto-pruning
concept.shortdesc: You can use regular expressions with organization- and repository-level auto-pruning policies in Red Hat Quay to match a subset of tags for removal.

conbody.p: Consider the following when using regular expressions with the auto-pruning feature:

ul.li: If a regular expression is not provided, the auto-pruner defaults to pruning all image tags in the organization or the repository. These are user-supplied and must be protected against ReDoS attacks.
Registry-wide policies do not currently support regular expressions. Only organization- and repository-level auto-pruning policies support regular expressions.
Regular expressions can be configured to prune images that either do, or do not, match the provided regex pattern.

conbody.p: Some of the following procedures provide example auto-pruning policies that use regular expressions that you can use as a reference when creating an auto-prune policy.
